Results.ReviewText: I had the regular 22” kettle, upgraded to the premium. Found it on clearance, so I got it at a good price. What can you say it’s a Weber. Great backyard charcoal grill. Next one will be be the 26” kettle.
Results.Title: Good as it gets!

Results.ReviewText: If you're into barbecuing Webber is always a great brand to start off with. That being said the family deserves a decent method of cooking their meal. This one had the features that I wanted and a few extras. Yes I would recommend it and yes I would buy it again!
Results.Title: Well worth the money!

Results.ReviewText: Best grill I have ever purchased in my 30 years of grilling. Will never buy anything else. Solid construction, easy ash dump and cleaning. And this this hold temp. Beer can chicken on now, and still at 450 after and hour. Can’t wait to do a Thanksgiving turkey!
Results.Title: Simply awesome

Results.ReviewText: I needed a new grill. The last one i bought was junk (kingsford) it looked good but thats it. Weber is versatile and consistent. It's the best product on the market for simplicity and durability.  Second one I owned. First one lasted 12 years. A must for any average family.
Results.Title: Good old Weber

Results.ReviewText: Lid where handle attaches chipped when i put the handle on.  Got a replacement lid and that one chipped too.  I did not overly tighten the handle.  Great grill but needs a little quality control attention to the coating.
Results.Title: Great grill but chips easily

Photos.Caption: Cooking the perfect steaks on our Weber.

Results.ReviewText: My husband and I have thought about Weber Grills for years but always wound up purchasing something less expensive. We finally purchased our Weber Charcoal Grill and couldn't be happier. The difference in food cooked on a Weber is truly unbelievable. I wish we wouldn't have waited so long. Don't be like us. Life is too short to not be enjoying a Weber.
Results.Title: Best Charcoal Grill We've Ever Owned

Results.ReviewText: I'm a newbie to Weber and it was love at first bite. I received a gas grill for my 50th (not a Weber) and spent more money in upkeep than I care to share. This kettle is a dream come true for FAR LESS $$$$. Food TASTES BETTER, and I smoked baby-back ribs for the first time in my life. They were awesome and I'll get better at it I'm sure! I want to grill daily now! I also bought a Weber Chimney and that thing completely rocks not needing that starting fluid (I might need a second Chimney). Another thing about this model I enjoy is the ash bucket on the bottom (that is SWEET)! After using the 22" Original Kettle Premium for only a few weeks, I wish I'd never gone with the "other brand" propane grill. Not sure I'll buy a Weber gas grill because I'm enjoying the coals too much, oh and the TASTE, oh and the FUN - I feel like a kid again. I get excited thinking about things to grill now. Hey Weber, you've got a new fan! Thanks for a great product line.
Results.Title: So Excited about Cooking with my 22" Weber Kettle

Results.ReviewText: weber grills are always durable, so i was suprized to see come paint chipping on this new one. I contacted customer service and they immediately had a new one shipped out to me. The grill works great. Was easy to assemble and easy to clean.
Results.Title: Initial paint chip immediately replaced

Results.ReviewText: I recently purchased this grill in green for Father’s Day for my husband. He loves it.  It arrived with a bent leg, and after a quick call Weber sent the replacement out without any hassle.  I looked at a lot of cheaper grills, and decided on this grill based on quality and durability.  We hope to enjoy it for years and years to come.
Results.Title: Great grill for a great price

Results.ReviewText: This is the only outdoor grill I would ever use to cook on. I love my Weber products.

Results.ReviewText: I finally bought this grill and love it. I grill at least 2 times per week

Results.ReviewText: We have owned numerous grills over the years ..love the company, but was a bit disappointed this time when buying my new kettle. It also had a drool in the paint but I am going to live with it. I like to scrape down my grill after doing wings.  Lots of powder spices makes a mess.  Just hoping I don't catch the run in the paint and create a bare spot.  Never saw this problem before.  But all in all, will always go with Weber, in fact just got a new Spirit II this week!

Results.ReviewText: My last experience with charcoal was with a small hibachi in college.  Before that it was my Dad's round flat charcoal grill with no airflow.  Both were a lot of trouble to use and clean up.  My wife insisted we leave gas and go back to charcoal, so we did.  The Weber Original Kettle is a breeze to use and clean up, and the results are great.  I have only used it twice so far, but my burgers and chicken breasts topped anything we ever cooked on gas.  The design is well thought out and the quality for the price can't be beat!

Not sure if anyone else has had this problem with their kettle lids. That being said I still will only buy Weber grills.

It allowed me to get a more accurate temapature. All i can say is that at this point I don’t plan on buying the other grill, this has met my needs above what I expected!

I like this one too, but the lid does not fit as securely over the lower kettle as my last one; as a consequence heat and smoke escape a little more than it should.  But overall, you can't replace the flavor of real charcoal grilling.

When the ash catcher on his Kettle was damaged he took one of the hubcaps of his VW beetle and used that. I’m on my 4th Kettle now and have enjoyed everything he taught me and have gone beyond that with the addition of the rotisserie. The one I recently purchased is for my daughter. She’s in college and will be renting a house where she can finally have a grill. Weber is truly a family heritage.

Results.ReviewText:
I received my copper Original Kettle Premium as a Christmas gift from my father-in-law in 2016.  I’ve always been a year round griller, but had traditionally been using gas for years.  I must say, I’m extremely impressed with my Kettle!  It has since replaced a (non-Weber) gas grill and a propane box smoker on its own. Steaks, burgers, brats, and chicken are so much better on the Weber! It’s been easier to control the heat, and the smokey flavor really ads to food. Plus, the 22” cooking surface offers tons of space to cook for plenty of people.  And learning to smoke.... easily the best ribs and pork shoulders I’ve ever made!  I’m pretty sure my neighbors get jealous when they smell the smoke from firing it up!

Not only is operation and cooking so easy, but so is clean up.  The one touch system makes clean up a breeze, and keeps the Kettle operating consistently. And given the quality of how it’s made, I’m sure this is going to be a gift I’ll have for the rest of my life.  Couldn’t be happier with my Weber Kettle!
Results.Title: Best Grill I’ve Ever Owned!

Results.ReviewText: This is and always has been a great grill.  It’s great quality and will last a long time. I was going to buy a more expensive pellet grill but as I and finding out, this can do everything a pellet grill can do!
Results.Title: Lives up to the Weber reputation.

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
